summary: Original 1,023-word walkthrough published on Substack under the Green Ledger byline. It documents a real Sourcey 3.7.1 build of the 1Password Connect OpenAPI 3.0.2 spec, including the exact scaffold command, generated config, npm install and build output, the 41-file static site, and four dated facts read from live Sourcey pages on 19 October 2026. The piece is public, readable without login, and carries the full command sequence so a reader can reproduce the build.

observations.claim: The piece is live and public without login
observations.evidence: HTTP 200 from the canonical Substack URL; page title and body text match the submitted piece.

observations.claim: The piece uses exactly one topic from the brief
observations.evidence: Topic 6: generating a docs site from an OpenAPI source with the open-source Sourcey generator, a real walkthrough on a real project.
observations.detail: The project is 1Password Connect, a production REST API, not a fixture.

observations.claim: Dated fact: Sourcey docs engine 3.7.1, released 18 October 2026, AGPL-3.0-only
observations.evidence: The live open source page lists version 3.7.1, 18 Oct 2026, and AGPL-3.0-only.

observations.claim: Dated fact: CLI requires Node.js 22.19 or later; init scaffolds the project; build writes static HTML to ./dist
observations.evidence: The live docs page states the Node requirement, the npx sourcey init scaffold, and the npm run build output path.

observations.claim: Dated fact: dev server at http://localhost:4400; inputs are OpenAPI, MCP, Doxygen, godoc, rustdoc, and Markdown
observations.evidence: The live docs page lists the dev server URL and the supported inputs.

observations.claim: Dated fact: public repository is AGPL-3.0 and last pushed 18 October 2026
observations.evidence: GitHub API metadata for sourcey/sourcey returned license AGPL-3.0 and pushed_at 2026-10-18T12:18:30Z.

observations.claim: The build was actually run, not described from documentation
observations.evidence: npx sourcey build printed Pages: 2, Output: /tmp/sy-demo/dist, Time: 2.4s; dist held 41 files and 1.9 MB; documents.json listed 2 pages, 15 operations, and 10 schemas.
observations.detail: npm install added 251 packages in 21s. The spec has 11 paths and 15 operations.

observations.claim: The published text contains no em dash or en dash
observations.evidence: A Unicode scan of the submitted body found no U+2013 or U+2014 characters.
